name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your ability scores each increase by 1.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

name: Variant Human
description: Humans of varied upbringing who gain a bonus skill and feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Skills
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.description: You gain one feat of your choice at 1st level.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

name: High Elf
description: High elves have keen minds and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed (Fey Ancestry)

name: Wood Elf
description: Wood elves have keen senses and intuition, and their fleet feet carry them quickly and stealthily through their native forests.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Trance

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed (Fey Ancestry)

name: Dark Elf (Drow)
description: Descended from an earlier subrace of dark-skinned elves, the drow were banished from the surface world and adapted to the Underdark.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: You know the dancing lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed (Fey Ancestry)

name: Half-Elf
description: Half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their elf and human parents.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your elf blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed (Fey Ancestry)

name: Hill Dwarf
description: Hill dwarves have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against Poison (Dwarven Resilience)

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against Poison (Dwarven Resilience)

name: Lightfoot Halfling
description: Lightfoot halflings can easily hide from notice, even using other people as cover.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

save_advantages: Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened (Brave)

name: Stout Halfling
description: Stout halflings are hardier than average and have some resistance to poison.

name: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn look very much like dragons standing erect in humanoid form, though they lack wings or a tail.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

name: Forest Gnome
description: Forest gnomes have a natural knack for illusion and inherent quickness and stealth.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

save_advantages: Advantage on INT, WIS, CHA saving throws against magic (Gnome Cunning)

name: Rock Gnome
description: Rock gnomes have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp).

save_advantages: Advantage on INT, WIS, CHA saving throws against magic (Gnome Cunning)

name: Half-Orc
description: Half-orcs’ grayish pigmentation, sloping foreheads, jutting jaws, prominent teeth, and towering builds make their orcish heritage plain for all to see.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your orc blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 feet).

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

name: Tiefling
description: To be greeted with stares and whispers, to suffer violence and insult on the street, to see mistrust and fear in every eye: this is the lot of the tiefling.

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke once per long rest. At 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest.
